categories.main_business_segments: Miracll Chemicals Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: polyurethane new materials (including TPU, PUR, PUD, PBS) and functional chemical raw materials (specialty isocyanates and specialty amines). The polyurethane segment focuses mainly on TPU products, which account for over 90% of sales, while the functional chemical raw materials segment produces specialty isocyanates such as HDI, CHDI, PPDI, and specialty amines like PNA, PPDA, and CHDA.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced continuous chemical production processes and proprietary technologies for polyurethane materials and specialty chemicals. It has developed differentiated product formulations and manufacturing processes, including molecular design of intermediates and additives for enhanced properties like UV resistance, anti-yellowing, and flame retardancy. The production lines are highly automated with DCS integrated control systems, enabling efficient and scalable manufacturing. The company also holds multiple patents related to core equipment, processes, and products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Miracll serves a diverse range of industries including consumer electronics, automotive manufacturing, sports and leisure, high-end equipment, green energy, home living, industrial coatings, sealing and transmission, 3D printing, and food hygiene. Its customers include direct downstream manufacturers and trading companies, with a focus on mid-to-high-end markets. The company has established stable relationships with benchmark customers in various application fields.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with two main production bases located in Yantai, Shandong Province, and Hebi, Henan Province. Its sales are predominantly domestic, accounting for over 90% of revenue, with a smaller portion exported internationally. The company’s subsidiaries and affiliated entities also operate within China, including Shanghai and Fujian regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Miracll operates mainly in the midstream and upstream segments of the chemical materials supply chain. It produces specialty monomers and raw materials (upstream) and manufactures polyurethane new materials (midstream) that are supplied to downstream manufacturers in various industries. The company aims to provide integrated solutions covering upstream monomers to downstream new materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment focused on product innovation, process optimization, and development of environmentally friendly and high-performance materials. Key R&D initiatives include developing foamed TPU, environmentally friendly adhesives (PUR, PUD), biodegradable materials (PBS), and specialty isocyanates and amines with improved performance and cost efficiency. It has established a postdoctoral research station and emphasizes talent cultivation and collaboration with customers to drive market-oriented innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Miracll generates revenue primarily through the sale of chemical products, including polyurethane materials and specialty chemical raw materials. Sales are conducted via direct sales to manufacturers and through distributors. The company’s revenue is largely product sales-based, with pricing influenced by raw material costs and market competition.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Miracll is the only publicly listed company in China focusing primarily on TPU products and has established a strong competitive position domestically. It has achieved partial import substitution and holds competitive advantages in product quality, technology innovation, and differentiated services. The specialty isocyanate and amine markets are oligopolistic globally, dominated by multinational companies, but Miracll is expanding capacity and technology to challenge this status quo.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Miracll reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.66 billion, representing a 12.42% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 77.6 million, a decrease of 11.7% compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets reached nearly RMB 3.85 billion, growing 14.75% from the prior year. It has been expanding production capacity and investing heavily in R&D, with a steady growth trajectory despite some profit margin pressure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Miracll emphasizes differentiated technology innovation and product customization to meet diverse customer needs. Its products feature superior mechanical properties, environmental resistance, and processing performance. The company leverages integrated upstream and midstream production capabilities to ensure stable supply, cost control, and quality assurance. Its strong R&D and technical service teams provide tailored solutions, enhancing customer loyalty and market competitiveness.
